_comment: Classes used in ng-zorro templates that antd v6 CSS does not style. `space` entries are temporary: remove each one once the component's template is aligned with antd v6. Categories: antd-emits (antd's own component emits it, v6 CSS never styles it); patch-motion (ng-zorro motion class styled by the component's style/v6/patch.css); nz-only (ng-zorro-only class with no antd counterpart: styled by the component's style/v6/patch.css, or an unstyled runtime state hook that no stylesheet targets — the component's own comment says which); v4-compat (v4 class kept next to its v6 replacement while v4 is the default; removable then); v4-compat (patch hook) (v4 class that style/v6/patch.css selects, so removing it needs a patch rewrite); scan-artefact (a literal the static scan picks up but that is never rendered as a class).
_button_comment: button's entries are permanent, not pending alignment: antd v6's own React Button emits ant-btn-color-link and the legacy ant-btn-{default,dashed,link,text,dangerous,rtl} type/danger/rtl classes for backward compatibility, but its v6 CSS never styles them (verified against node_modules/antd/es/button/style). class-coverage.spec.ts pins this exact set so it can't silently grow.
_notification_comment: antd-emits: -close-icon (on the close anticon, PurePanel.js; v6 styles only -notice-close). v4-compat: -notice-content (next to -notice-wrapper), -notice-message (next to -notice-title), -notice-btn (next to -notice-actions), -notice-close-x (inner close span). v4-compat (patch hook): -notice-with-icon (next to -notice-section; the patch indents the text of notices with an icon). patch-motion: -fade-enter, -fade-leave.
_message_comment: v4-compat: -notice-content (next to -notice-wrapper), -{success,info,warning,error,loading} (runtime type class on -custom-content; v6 colours -notice-icon-{type} instead). v4-compat (patch hook): -custom-content (parent of icon and title; v4's `.ant-message .anticon` colour rules need it and the patch gives it v6's flex row). patch-motion: -move-up-enter, -move-up-leave.
_input_comment: antd-emits: -affix-wrapper-readonly (BaseInput.js sets it on the affix wrapper unconditionally; v6 CSS never styles it), -password (Password.js's wrapper className; v6 styles only the -password-icon it contains), -search-with-button (Search.js emits `${prefixCls}-with-button` on its root whenever an enter button is configured; v6 has no CSS for it, only for the button's own -search-btn[-filled] classes), -wrapper (rc-component/input's BaseInput.js still concatenates `${prefixCls}-wrapper` onto its group span alongside -group; confirmed by dumping antd's own addon demo — v6 CSS never styles it). v4-compat: -affix-wrapper-outlined (v4's affix wrapper variant lookup uses this prefix; v6's own variant rule targets the bare `ant-input-outlined` class added alongside it — -filled/-borderless/-underlined are the same shape but never render in the current demos, so they stay unlisted until a demo exercises them), -affix-wrapper-status-error/-warning (kept for the default v4 stylesheet, which keys the affix wrapper's status border off this prefix; v6's own status rule targets the bare `ant-input-status-error/-warning` classes added alongside it), -affix-wrapper-textarea-with-clear-btn (v4's textarea clear-button spacing hook; v6's equivalent spacing rule keys off `ant-input-textarea-affix-wrapper.ant-input-affix-wrapper`, added alongside it, so the patch no longer needs to select this class), -focused (v4-only; v6 uses -affix-wrapper-focused instead), -search-button (ng-zorro's own button element class, kept next to v6's -search-btn).
_input-number_comment: antd-emits: -in-form-item (InternalInputNumber's className builder sets `${prefixCls}-in-form-item` from FormItemInputContext unconditionally; v6 CSS never styles it). v4-compat (replacement named — a v6 class was added alongside these in this diff): -handler, -handler-down[-disabled], -handler-up[-disabled] (kept next to the new -action/-action-{up,down}[-disabled] classes), -group-addon (kept next to the new -addon class). v4-compat (no v6 counterpart at all): -handler-down-inner, -handler-up-inner (RcInputNumber's StepHandler only renders its own -action-{up,down}-inner span when no custom icon is passed, and antd always passes one, so no v6 markup ever needs this class), -group, -group-wrapper, -group-wrapper-rtl, -wrapper, -input-wrap (v6's InputNumber never wraps prefix/suffix or legacy addonBefore/After in this nested wrapper/group/input-wrap structure at all — RcInputNumber renders `-prefix`/`-suffix`/`<input>` as direct children of the single root div, and legacy addons render through Space.Compact + bare `-addon` spans around the root). v4-compat (patch hook — style/v6/patch.css selects these to mirror antd's `.ant-input-affix-wrapper`/`.ant-input-outlined`/legacy `.ant-input-group*` rules onto the ant-input-number-* names, since v6 has no rule of its own for any of them): -affix-wrapper-outlined, -affix-wrapper-disabled, -affix-wrapper-focused, -affix-wrapper-status-error, -affix-wrapper-status-warning, -affix-wrapper-rtl, -group-wrapper-outlined (-filled/-borderless/-underlined and -group-wrapper-status-error/-warning are the same shape but never render in the current demos, so they stay unlisted and un-patched until a demo exercises them). nz-only (unstyled runtime state hook that no stylesheet, v4 or v6 patch, targets): -affix-wrapper-readonly.
_space_comment: antd-emits: -horizontal (antd's own Space still renders `${prefixCls}-${orientation}` for the horizontal default, verified against a live antd render; v6 CSS has no rule for it since horizontal needs no styling), -item-separator (Space.Item's own hook class; v6 CSS defines no rule for it either, since the separator's appearance comes from the ReactNode passed in, not from CSS). v4-compat: -split (superseded by -item-separator, the antd v6 name for the separator element, kept next to it for v4 rendering).
_skeleton_comment: antd-emits: -avatar-square, -button-square (shape classes v6 CSS never styles). v4-compat: -content (next to -section).
_spin_comment: v4-compat: -show-text (root flag when nzTip is set), -text (next to -description). v4-compat (patch hook): -nested-loading, -blur (the patch mirrors v6's -section and -spinning rules onto them).
_rate_comment: nz-only: -star-active, -star-focused, -star-zero (runtime state hooks on the hovered/focused/unfilled star from `updateStarStyle`; no stylesheet, v4 or v6, styles them — kept because removing them from the rendered DOM is a consumer-visible change, and `rate-v6.spec.ts` asserts `-star-zero`).
_switch_comment: nz-only: -click-animating-node (the wave-effect node `nz-wave` renders on click; a v4-only ripple, no v6 stylesheet targets it since v6 Switch has no click ripple).
_checkbox_comment: antd-emits: -group-rtl, -rtl (antd's own component emits the -rtl variants), -wrapper-checked, -wrapper-in-form-item (antd adds these inside Form.Item / when checked; v6 CSS never styles them). v4-compat: -group-item (v4-only structural hook on a grouped checkbox; no v6 counterpart). v4-compat (patch hook): -inner (v6 draws the box on `.ant-checkbox` itself; style/v6/patch.css mirrors those rules onto -inner, so removing it needs a patch rewrite).
_radio_comment: antd-emits: -button-checked, -button-disabled, -button-input (rc-checkbox's Checkbox.js renders `span.{prefixCls}[-checked][-disabled] > input.{prefixCls}-input` with prefixCls `ant-radio-button` in button mode, so these three are genuinely emitted unstyled), -button-wrapper-rtl, -wrapper-checked, -wrapper-in-form-item (antd's own component emits them; v6 CSS never styles them). v4-compat (patch hook): -inner (rc-checkbox never renders an inner span; it is an ng-zorro-only structural element. v6 draws the dot on `.ant-radio` itself, so style/v6/patch.css mirrors those rules onto -inner, and removing it needs a patch rewrite). v4-compat: -button-inner (same ng-zorro-only structural element for the button variant, but style/v6/patch.css never selects it — the pill's appearance comes entirely from `.ant-radio-button-wrapper`'s own background/border, so removing it needs no patch change).
_result_comment: v4-compat: -content (next to -body). antd-emits: -403, -404, -500 (exception-status root classes; v6 renders the SVG illustration without styling them).
_alert_comment: v4-compat: -action (next to -actions), -content (next to -section), -message (next to -title), -closable (no v6 rule or replacement). nz-only: -marquee, -marquee-pause-on-hover, -marquee-track (ng-zorro's looping banner, styled by the patch). antd-emits: -no-icon.
_tooltip_comment: antd-emits: -open (the trigger's visibility class). scan-artefact: ant-zoom-big-fast (the `_animationPrefix` literal; only the -enter/-leave variants built from it are rendered, and v6's motion CSS styles those).
_tree_comment: antd-emits (verified against node_modules/@rc-component/tree/es/TreeNode.js and node_modules/antd/es/tree/Tree.js; absent from manifest.json's tree.classes): -icon-hide (Tree.js's `${prefixCls}-icon-hide` when `!showIcon`), -indent-unit-start (Indent.js's `${baseClassName}-start` for a start-of-row indent unit), -node-content-wrapper-open/-close (TreeNode.js's `${wrapClass}-${nodeState}`), -treenode-checkbox-checked/-indeterminate/-loading and -treenode-switcher-open/-close (TreeNode.js's own className builders). v4-compat (patch hook): -checkbox-inner (v6 draws the checkbox box on `.ant-tree-checkbox` itself, the same shape as checkbox/radio/cascader; style/v6/patch.css mirrors it onto -inner with the tree prefix). Every entry appears twice (bare `ant-tree-*` and `ant-select-tree-*`): NzTreeNodeBuiltinComponent/NzTreeNodeSwitcherComponent/NzTreeIndentComponent/NzTreeNodeTitleComponent emit both forms from the same host-binding pair, gated on `nzSelectMode`.
_tree-select_comment: nz-only: -not-found (the empty-content wrapper span; antd's OptionList.js renders notFoundContent with no wrapper class at all, confirmed absent from antd/@rc-component sources), -close-icon (reused from select's own NzSelectClearComponent; same nz-only reasoning as select's `_select_comment`). v4-compat (patch hook, reusing select's Task 9 box/wrap/content/search patch verbatim since tree-select's root also carries the bare `ant-select` class and reuses select's `nz-select-search`/`nz-select-placeholder` components): -selection-wrap, -selector, -selection-search, -selection-search-mirror. v4-compat (replacement added alongside on the same element, mirroring select's own resolution, some via the reused select subcomponents): -selection-overflow (ant-select-content), -selection-overflow-item (ant-select-content-item), -selection-overflow-item-suffix (ant-select-content-item-suffix), -selection-placeholder (ant-select-placeholder), -selection-search-input (ant-select-input), -tree-dropdown meaning ant-select-tree-dropdown (ant-tree-select-dropdown, the real antd v6 class name — confirmed in manifest.json, verified in node_modules/antd/es/tree-select/index.js's `treeSelectPrefixCls`). antd-emits (rendered here because tree-select's own demos render an `nz-tree[nzSelectMode]`; same antd-source citations as `_tree_comment`): -tree-icon-hide, -tree-indent-unit-start, -tree-node-content-wrapper-open/-close, -tree-treenode-switcher-open/-close; ant-tree-select (TreeSelect's own root class from the tree-select source above; v6 CSS styles only its `-dropdown[-rtl]` children, not the bare root, since the select box comes from the shared `ant-select` classes).
_popover_comment: v4-compat: -inner-content (next to -content). antd-emits: -open (the trigger's visibility class). scan-artefact: ant-zoom-big (the `_animationPrefix` literal; only the -enter/-leave variants built from it are rendered, and v6's motion CSS styles those).
_popconfirm_comment: v4-compat: ant-popover-buttons, ant-popover-inner-content, ant-popover-message, ant-popover-message-icon, ant-popover-message-title (next to their ant-popconfirm-* replacements). antd-emits: ant-popover-open (the trigger's visibility class), ant-popconfirm-inner-content, ant-popconfirm-message-text (antd emits both; v6 styles only their children). scan-artefact: ant-zoom-big (the `_animationPrefix` literal, as for popover).
_drawer_comment: v4-compat (patch hook): -wrapper-body (kept as the flex container; the patch mirrors v6's -section layout onto it). antd-emits: -header-close-only, -open (the patch uses -open only in `:not(.ant-drawer-open)` for the closed-panel shadow).
_modal_comment: antd-emits: -close-icon (the anticon inside -close; v6 styles only -close and -close-x), -confirm-content (ConfirmDialog.js; v6 styles it only under the -confirm-paragraph wrapper ng-zorro does not render, and the patch places it in the confirm grid). v4-compat: -content (next to -container). No -confirm-paragraph wrapper is added: v4's confirm.less adjacent-sibling rule needs the title and content to stay siblings of the icon.
_progress_comment: v4-compat: -bg (next to -track), -success-bg (next to -track-success), -outer (next to -body), -steps-outer (next to -steps-body), -text (next to -indicator), -default (no v6 rule or replacement). antd-emits: -circle-trail (v6 styles the renamed -circle-rail), -show-info (root flag), -status-normal (runtime status class; v6 styles only the other statuses).
_float-button_comment: antd-emits: -group-trigger (patch styles it only in a square-group compound selector), -primary, -default (the host's -{type} class; colours come from nz-button's ant-btn-color-* classes). v4-compat: -group-circle-shadow, -group-square-shadow (v4 shadow toggles), -top (BackTop's v4 class). v4-compat (patch hook): -body, -description, -group-wrap (next to -group-list), -inner. nz-only: -group-circle, -group-square (shape class on the group root; antd passes the shape through context and has no such class). patch-motion: -enter-{top,bottom,left,right}, -leave-{top,bottom,left,right}.
_upload_comment: antd-emits: -list-item-image (the thumbnail ``, styled only by the picture/picture-card/circle list rule scoped to `.ant-upload-list-item-thumbnail img`; ListItem.js renders it unscoped for every list type), -list-item-extra (ListItem.js's own `extra` span; v6 CSS never styles it), -list-item-done (ListItem.js's `${prefixCls}-list-item-${mergedStatus}` for every status, but v6 CSS only styles the `-error`/`-uploading` variants), -list-text (UploadList/index.js's own `${prefixCls}-list-${listType}` for every list type; v6 CSS styles only the `-picture`/`-picture-card`/`-picture-circle` variants). v4-compat (patch hook): -list-item-info, -upload-span (kept as the icon/name wrapper for the default stylesheet; style/v6/patch.css collapses both to `display:contents` so their children lay out as the real v6 markup's direct flex children of `.ant-upload-list-item`). v4-compat: -list-item-card-actions, -list-item-card-actions-btn, -text-icon (each kept next to its v6 replacement — `-list-item-actions`, `-list-item-action`, `-icon` — added alongside it on the same element), -list-text-container, -list-picture-container, -list-picture-card-container (v4's per-item wrapper naming, kept next to the new `-list-item-container` on the same element), -select-text, -select-picture, -select-picture-card (v4's per-listType trigger sizing hook; real antd's `Upload.js` never appends a listType suffix to `-select` at all, v6 instead sizes the picture-card trigger through `.ant-upload-wrapper.ant-upload-picture-card-wrapper .ant-upload.ant-upload-select`, so there is no same-name v6 counterpart to add). nz-only: -list-item-list-type-text, -list-item-list-type-picture, -list-item-list-type-picture-card (ng-zorro-only structural hook on the item root; no stylesheet, v4 or v6, targets it).
_mention_comment: antd-emits: -focused (Mentions.js's own `classNames.mentions` builder sets `${prefixCls}-focused` on the root from React state; v6 CSS never styles it, keying focus visuals off `:focus-within` instead).
_slider_comment: antd-emits: -rtl (Slider's own root className builder in `antd/es/slider/index.js` sets `${prefixCls}-rtl`; v6 CSS has no rule for it). v4-compat: -mark-active (kept next to its v6 replacement, -mark-text-active, added alongside it on the same mark-text span).
_select_comment: antd-emits: -selection-item-disabled (@rc-component/select MultipleContent.js emits `${selectionItemPrefixCls}-disabled` on a disabled tag; v6 CSS never styles this exact class, only the bare .ant-select-selection-item it decorates). nz-only: -arrow-loading (ng-zorro's own hook on nz-select-arrow; antd's loading swap is a bare LoadingOutlined icon with no such class, and no v6 CSS rule targets it), -close-icon (ng-zorro's own hook on the default clear icon; antd's default clearIcon is a bare CloseCircleFilled with no wrapper class), -selected-icon (ng-zorro's own hook on the option check icon; antd's default menuItemSelectedIcon is a bare CheckOutlined inside .ant-select-item-option-state, no such class, and no v6 CSS rule targets it). v4-compat (patch hook): -selection-search (v6 has no wrapper for the search input at all in single mode, and in multiple mode the role is played by .ant-select-content-item-suffix, added alongside; style/v6/patch.css selects this class to size the multi-mode input/mirror with v6 tokens, so removing it needs a patch rewrite), -selection-search-mirror (v6 sizes its search input via a CSS custom property written by its own JS; ng-zorro has no code path that writes it and keeps the old mirror-measurement technique instead, so style/v6/patch.css selects this class), -selection-wrap (v6 has no wrapper at all around .ant-select-content/-prefix/-suffix — they are flat children of the select root; style/v6/patch.css selects this class to give it the position/layout v4's own mixin gave it, so .ant-select-selection-placeholder still has a sized, positioned ancestor), -selector (v6 draws the select's box directly on the root .ant-select; style/v6/patch.css mirrors that box onto this class and neutralises the root's, so removing it needs a patch rewrite). v4-compat: -selection-overflow (replacement: ant-select-content, added alongside on the same element), -selection-overflow-item (replacement: ant-select-content-item, added alongside), -selection-overflow-item-suffix (replacement: ant-select-content-item-suffix, added alongside), -selection-placeholder (replacement: ant-select-placeholder, added alongside on nz-select-placeholder's host), -selection-search-input (replacement: ant-select-input, added alongside on the input element).
